data.content: # Panthers bring win streak into game against the Senators. Published Oct. 20, 2026 4:10 a.m. ET. Florida Panthers (5-2-2, in the Atlantic Division) vs. Ottawa Senators (6-3, in the Atlantic Division). BOTTOM LINE: The Florida Panthers seek to extend a three-game win streak with a victory over the Ottawa Senators. Ottawa has a 6-3 record overall and a 2-1-0 record in Atlantic Division play. The Senators rank 10th in the league serving 10.3 penalty minutes per game. Florida is 5-2-2 overall and 0-1-0 against the Atlantic Division. The Panthers serve 12.8 penalty minutes per game to rank third in the league. The teams meet Wednesday for the first time this season. data.title: Brentford 1-2 Liverpool (Oct 17, 2026) Game Analysis - ESPN
data.content: 2-4-1, 10 PTS. # Brentford v Liverpool. # Alexander Isak completes Liverpool comeback at nine-man Brentford. Updated: Oct 17, 2026, 12:14 pm. Alexander Isak marked his return from injury with the winner as Liverpool came from behind to beat nine-man Brentford 2-1. The Reds were misfiring as they trailed to Keane Lewis-Potter's first-half goal, but the match turned on a needless red card for Brentford's Yehor Yarmoliuk on the stroke of half-time. Víctor Muñoz hauled Liverpool level after the break before Isak struck with his fifth goal of the season. Brentford then lost Vitaly Janelt to second yellow card in stoppage time. Swedish striker Isak had missed the previous two matches but was able start alongside Florian Wirtz and recent signing Bradley Barcola in a £350million frontline. © ESPN Enterprises, Inc.
